_note: VEML7700 high-accuracy ambient light sensor module (Vishay). I2C interface, fixed address 0x10. 4-pin breakout: VCC, GND, SDA, SCL. 16-bit resolution, 0-120000 lux range. Programmable gain (1x, 2x, 1/8x, 1/4x) and integration time (25-800 ms). Spectral response close to human eye (photopic). Filtron photodiode technology.
